description: ROUTE one board vehicle, read-only: a crypto vehicle is quoted across every venue — the DEX router, the EventTrader order book and, when connected, the user's own exchange — and the venue with the best net output is chosen (nothing is placed; theme_journey_trade_vehicle places it after confirm_action). For a card, theme, stock, fund or WTA market it returns that vehicle's own setup (the tool or page that trades it) instead of a quote. (no key needed)

conversation_id.description: conversation_id returned by an earlier theme_journey_* call (keeps an anonymous visitor's interests and basket together until they register).

symbol.description: the board symbol (e.g. QRL, THEME:<slug>, CARD:<id>, WTA:<id>) or the specialist agent's name the user said (e.g. Nightfox)

usdc_amount.description: ticket size in USD from the user's own balance (their USDT spends 1:1)
